reviews.text: Most amazing place for any pet need!

The groomer was very condescending and passive aggressive from the first moment, when she refused to address me upon entering. I had to say good morning twice and take my dog out of his travel bag before she said "hello," followed by scanning me up and down.

She was making inappropriate comments such as, "poor baby, it looks like you have never been groomed before in your life," and when inspecting my dog's coat she was saying things like, "oh yes, poor baby, you are so dirty and matted, poor you." These comments were completely unnecessary and offensive, as if my dog was neglected or in poor condition, when I just wanted regular upkeep of his coat and he had two mats behind his ears, not a bad case at all. When I showed her the image of the haircut I wanted, she said, "well, that is clearly not him," while laughing. Her facial expression also seemed bothered by me speaking to the man at the cash register, as I was speaking to him in Spanish.

The grooming itself was fine, it was what I expected, but I did not care for her attitude, her condescending tone, or her disrespectful remarks. Id even go as far as saying I felt she was being racially biased towards me as a client. At one point, when she took my dog in, the nice cashier asked me if I was okay because I was visibly bothered, and I told him that I really hated her attitude and that it had upset me a great deal. He apologized on her behalf. When I came back to pick up my dog, she did not come to me to apologize or say anything, despite being aware of the discomfort she caused, since the cashier told me he had spoken to her.

Unfortunately I won’t be coming back, I much rather go to the competitor service and be treated with basic respect, than repeating this experience again… I get that her job is to deal with pets, but there is minimum of people skills required to give a service.

Went in intending to buy a bag of cat food, but the employee made the whole experience pretty unpleasant. None of the bags had prices on them, so I asked if she could scan a few for me. She seemed visibly annoyed about having to do it and would only respond with the price, nothing else.

After she told me the price, I was still looking around, and she immediately said, “It’s over here,” pointing me toward the checkout. It really felt like she just wanted me to pay and leave.

I also asked whether any of the wet food was on sale. She said, “All the wet food is on the shelf.” I clarified that I meant whether there were any promotions or discounts, and she just repeated, “All the wet food is on the shelf.”

At that point I got the message, she clearly did not want to interact or help at all. I ended up not buying anything and left. I don’t think I’ll be going back.

I took my two cocker spaniels to be groomed yesterday. The welcome at the salon was very pleasant; it's a nice, well-maintained shop. Unfortunately, the grooming was a disaster. I think we misunderstood each other because of the language barrier. The person was an English speaker and said she understood me, but nothing was done as I had asked. The woman claimed to have many years of experience and groomed the dogs very quickly, too quickly in my opinion. There was a lot of unshaven hair showing, and the cut wasn't what I had requested. I'm giving two stars for the shop, but the grooming deserves only one star. Perhaps they could speak more with the client or have an interpreter in the future to better understand clients who speak Quebec's national language.
